form.description:
Welcome to the Security Advisors, a mutually beneficial program where members have engagement opportunities and access to exclusive member information and other benefits with participating Microsoft product engineering teams (Security Advisors). 

Participation in Security Advisors Program is voluntary. To opt-out of the Security Advisors Program at any time, visit: https://aka.ms/SecurityAdvisors/OptOut 

    Membership Requirements    Experienced in managing Security Customer Community productsCommitted to using Security Customer Communities private previews and providing feedbackEnthusiastic about community engagementDedicated to maintaining confidentiality
This sign-up form is used for participating in these Microsoft Security Advisors Programs:

Management Advisors Program
Microsoft Intune, Windows Cloud and Windows Commercial

Microsoft Entra Advisors Program
Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Entra ID Protection, Microsoft Entra ID Governance, Microsoft Entra External ID, Microsoft Entra Verified ID, Microsoft Entra Workload ID, Microsoft Entra Internet Access, Microsoft Entra Private Access
 
Microsoft Purview Advisors Program
Microsoft Purview products: Information Protection, Data Loss Prevention, Insider Risk Management, Data Governance, eDiscovery, Audit, Data Lifecycle Management, Records Management and Microsoft Priva

Microsoft Threat Protection Advisors Program
Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender products, Azure network security services

Members use of private previews provided under the Security Advisors Program are subject to their own license terms that accompany those products and services.  

Please review the Security Advisors Program Code of Conduct that applies to all Security Advisors.

descriptiveQuestions.subtitle:
As a Security Advisors Program Member, you can choose to be eligible to receive Digital Badges (digital credentials) and reward points to put towards Microsoft Swag in recognition of your meaningful contributions and feedback to engineering groups of Microsoft security services in the scope of this community.    

 Microsoft has contracted with Credly, Inc. to deliver, host, and manage our digital credentials issued by the private community program. For detailed information on Credly’s Digital Credentialing Platform, please go to https://info.credly.com/how-credly-works.  
   
 By opting-in to this benefit, you allow Microsoft to share the following personal information with Credly: your first name, your last name, and the e-mail address you provide to Security Advisors Program.  

Members who have enrolled in this benefit can make their badges public or private. When earning Digital Badges, you can make them private by leaving them in your digital credentials’ library in your Credly account. You can make them public by publishing them on social media and digital portals of your choice.  

Microsoft has contracted with Stadium to deliver, host, and manage our reward points issued by the private community program. For detailed information on Stadium's Swag Platform, please go to https://www.bystadium.com/

Microsoft works with Credly and Stadium to host and manage digital badges and community rewards. You can review their privacy policies at: Credly: https://www.youracclaim.com/privacy & Stadium: https://www.bystadium.com/privacy-policy
  
By opting-in to this benefit, you allow Microsoft to share the following personal information with Stadium: the e-mail address you provide to Security Advisors Program.
   
 You may opt out of the Member Recognition Benefits at any time by visiting: https://aka.ms/SecurityAdvisors/OptOut 

When you opt out:Microsoft will stop sharing your personal information with the vendors that support the program (including Credly and Stadium).You will no longer receive digital badges, reward points, or access to the rewards shop as part of this program.Any badges or reward points previously issued will remain in your Credly or Stadium accounts unless you choose to close those accounts directly with the vendor.

 If you wish to delete your Credly or Stadium accounts, please contact those vendors using the instructions provided in their respective privacy policies. Microsoft cannot close those accounts on your behalf.

** Providing feedback is voluntary. Microsoft treats feedback as non-confidential information, freely able to use for any Microsoft purpose. Members should exercise care to ensure that all feedback provided to Microsoft does not contain their confidential information. 

Confidentiality Obligations 
Microsoft and Members will keep confidential anything marked Confidential Information, shared or discussed in any format. Members will not engage in related discussions with any employees, contractors, outside agents or other personnel in its organization or outside not directly involved in this program. The Security Advisors Program, its program materials and documents, including but not limited to, private previews, product road maps, Teams community call discussions, and surveys are Microsoft Confidential Information. 

Confidential Information. “Confidential Information” is non-public information that is designated “confidential” or that a reasonable person should understand is confidential, including, but not limited to, private previews, product updates and roadmaps, and engineering team communications. Confidential Information does not include information that (1) becomes publicly available without a breach of a confidentiality obligation; (2) you received lawfully from another source without a confidentiality obligation; (3) is independently developed; or (4) is a comment or suggestion volunteered about Microsoft’s business, products, or services.
 
Microsoft and Members will take reasonable steps to protect the other’s Confidential Information and will use the other party’s Confidential Information only for purposes of the parties’ business relationship. 

Neither party will disclose Confidential Information to third parties, except to its representatives.

A “representative” is an employee, contractor, advisor or consultant of one of us or one of our respective affiliates. 

Each of us may disclose the other’s Confidential Information to representatives only if they have a need to know about it for purposes of our business relationship with each other. Before doing so, each of us must:ensure that representatives are required to protect the Confidential Information on terms consistent with this agreement; and accept responsibility for each representative’s use of Confidential Information. Disclosure required by law. A party may disclose the other’s Confidential Information if required by law, but only after it notifies the other party (if legally permissible) to enable the other party to seek a protective order. 

Questions about Security Advisors Program can be directed to https://aka.ms/SecurityAdvisors/Help

Do you acknowledge and agree to uphold the confidentiality obligations outlined in the Security Advisors Program, including protecting Microsoft Confidential Information and limiting disclosure to authorized representatives only?

Confidentiality Obligations 
Microsoft and Members will keep confidential anything marked Confidential Information, shared or discussed in any format. Members will not engage in related discussions with any employees, contractors, outside agents or other personnel in its organization or outside not directly involved in this program. The MCCP Program, its program materials and documents, including but not limited to, private previews, product road maps, Teams community call discussions, and surveys are Microsoft Confidential Information. 

Confidential Information. “Confidential Information” is non-public information that is designated “confidential” or that a reasonable person should understand is confidential, including, but not limited to, private previews, product updates and roadmaps, and engineering team communications. Confidential Information does not include information that (1) becomes publicly available without a breach of a confidentiality obligation; (2) you received lawfully from another source without a confidentiality obligation; (3) is independently developed; or (4) is a comment or suggestion volunteered about Microsoft’s business, products, or services.
 
Microsoft and Members will take reasonable steps to protect the other’s Confidential Information and will use the other party’s Confidential Information only for purposes of the parties’ business relationship. 

Neither party will disclose Confidential Information to third parties, except to its representatives.

A “representative” is an employee, contractor, advisor or consultant of one of us or one of our respective affiliates. 

Each of us may disclose the other’s Confidential Information to representatives only if they have a need to know about it for purposes of our business relationship with each other. Before doing so, each of us must:ensure that representatives are required to protect the Confidential Information on terms consistent with this agreement; and accept responsibility for each representative’s use of Confidential Information. Disclosure required by law. A party may disclose the other’s Confidential Information if required by law, but only after it notifies the other party (if legally permissible) to enable the other party to seek a protective order.

form.title: Security Advisors Program Member Sign-up
form.formsProRTDescription:
Welcome to the Security Advisors, a mutually beneficial program where members have engagement opportunities and access to exclusive member information and other benefits with participating Microsoft product engineering teams (Security Advisors). 

Participation in Security Advisors Program is voluntary. To opt-out of the Security Advisors Program at any time, visit: https://aka.ms/SecurityAdvisors/OptOut 

 Membership Requirements
  • Experienced in managing Security Customer Community products
  • Committed to using Security Customer Communities private previews and providing feedback
  • Enthusiastic about community engagement
  • Dedicated to maintaining confidentiality

This sign-up form is used for participating in these Microsoft Security Advisors Programs:

Management Advisors Program
Microsoft Intune, Windows Cloud and Windows Commercial

Microsoft Entra Advisors Program
Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Entra ID Protection, Microsoft Entra ID Governance, Microsoft Entra External ID, Microsoft Entra Verified ID, Microsoft Entra Workload ID, Microsoft Entra Internet Access, Microsoft Entra Private Access
Microsoft Purview Advisors Program
Microsoft Purview products: Information Protection, Data Loss Prevention, Insider Risk Management, Data Governance, eDiscovery, Audit, Data Lifecycle Management, Records Management and Microsoft Priva

Microsoft Threat Protection Advisors Program
Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender products, Azure network security services

Members use of private previews provided under the Security Advisors Program are subject to their own license terms that accompany those products and services.  

Please review the Security Advisors Program Code of Conduct that applies to all Security Advisors.
